verdicts.reason: A shrinks the pink panel to a small stamp with 'YOUR SPACE' jammed flush against its right edge and the arrow rows cramped. The thin zigzag slivers over the windows look like leftovers, and the right third of the banner is dead white wall. B keeps the original's zigzag-edged pink panel with the headline centred and some breathing room, but the copy is still small and the chevron strip runs into the pendant lamps. B also leaves the right third empty, so neither is shippable, but B reads as the same design.
